name: opnform
label: Opnform
description: Create beautiful online forms and surveys with unlimited fields and submissions

baseApiUrl.label: Base URL
baseApiUrl.description: Default value is 'https://api.opnform.com'. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

opnform_get_current_user.label: Get Current User
opnform_get_current_user.description: Gets the OpnForm user that owns the connected API key.

opnform_update_workspace.label: Update Workspace
opnform_update_workspace.description: Renames a workspace or changes its icon.

workspaceId.label: Workspace ID
workspaceId.description: Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.

name.label: Name
name.description: New workspace name. Leave empty to keep the current name.

emoji.label: Emoji
emoji.description: New emoji icon, e.g. "🚀". Leave empty to keep the current icon.

opnform_list_forms.label: List Forms
opnform_list_forms.description: Lists one page of forms in a workspace.

workspaceId.label: Workspace ID
workspaceId.description: Numeric workspace ID, e.g. "12". Use List Workspaces to find it.

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

opnform_get_form.label: Get Form
opnform_get_form.description: Gets a form with all its settings and fields.

formSlug.label: Form Slug
formSlug.description: The form slug or UUID (the `slug` field), e.g. "customer-feedback-x1y2z3". Use List Forms to find it.

opnform_list_submissions.label: List Submissions
opnform_list_submissions.description: Lists one page of submissions for a form.

formId.label: Form ID
formId.description: Numeric form ID (the `id` field, not the slug), e.g. "42". Use List Forms to find it.

search.label: Search
search.description: Optional text to search for in the answers.

status.label: Status
status.description: completed, partial (unfinished submissions, on forms with partial submissions enabled) or all. Leave empty for the API default.

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

formId.label: Form ID
formId.description: Numeric form ID (the `id` field, not the slug), e.g. "42". Use List Forms to find it.

submissionId.label: Submission ID
submissionId.description: Numeric submission ID, from List Submissions.
